description: The exact bytes of the two settlement preimages a node PRODUCES: the per-leaf preimage that hashes to a settlement leaf, and the batch-binding preimage whose digest becomes the on-chain memo.
why_this_is_a_primitive: These two preimages already appear inside the P001 conformance fixture, but only as part of a verifier verdict. A verifier CONSUMES them; a node and the issuance service PRODUCE them. A producer needs the byte contract on its own terms — the same way level1-binding and operator-receipt have theirs — so that a producer can be checked without running a full verification. The values here are derived from P001 and cross-checked against it: same bytes, stated as a producer contract.
canonicalization: INSERTION-ORDERED compact JSON — no spaces, no trailing newline, keys in the order declared below. NOT JCS. This is the same choice level1-binding and capacity-evidence make, and the opposite of operator-receipt and submission-set, which are JCS. Neither can be guessed from the other; each artifact pins its own.
two_canonicalizations_note: Both tripwire digests below are the values JCS would have produced. They are pinned so an implementation that reaches for sorted keys — the natural wrong guess, and the one a JSON library gives you by default — fails against a stated value instead of drifting silently.
cross_reference: These are P001's own preimages. A change here that does not also change fixtures/conformance/P001 means one of the two is wrong.

leaf_preimage.hash_rule: leaf_hash = SHA3-256(0x00 || insertion_ordered_bytes). The 0x00 prefix is the leaf domain separator of the settlement Merkle tree; internal nodes use 0x01. Omitting it makes a leaf hash collide with a raw digest of the same bytes, which is what the separator exists to prevent.
leaf_preimage.leaf_bound_field_note: `subtree_root` is the leaf-bound value (independence.proof/1 §10.4): the Merkle root over the leaf's accepted commitment_ids. An implementation that binds a single commitment_id here instead produces a leaf no verifier resolves.

batch_binding_preimage.digest_rule: memo = "ccab1:" || SHA3-256(insertion_ordered_bytes), lowercase hex. No domain prefix here — unlike the leaf hash, this digest is not a Merkle leaf.

quantity_note: Quantities are STRINGS with their scale preserved ("5.00", not "5" or 5). The scale is part of the signed bytes: a producer that normalizes "5.00" to "5", or emits a JSON number, changes the digest. This is the same discipline the rest of the suite applies to quantities.
profile_resolution_note: `settlement_profile_id` inside both preimages MUST be the profile the rules domain resolves to (see rules-domain/vectors.json), never a compile-time constant. Taking it from a constant hashes the wrong substrate's identifier into the leaf — and every digest still looks internally consistent.

negative_cases.name: JCS instead of insertion order
negative_cases.scenario: either preimage canonicalized with sorted keys
negative_cases.why: the pinned tripwire digests are what this produces; both differ from the contract

negative_cases.name: leaf hashed without the 0x00 domain prefix
negative_cases.why: the leaf is then indistinguishable from an internal node or a bare digest of the same bytes

negative_cases.name: quantity scale normalized
negative_cases.why: different bytes, different digest — and the two representations are equal as numbers, so nothing numeric catches it

negative_cases.name: quantity emitted as a JSON number
negative_cases.why: JSON numbers have no fixed textual form; the contract carries quantities as strings precisely to avoid that

negative_cases.name: settlement_profile_id from a constant
negative_cases.scenario: the profile id is taken from a compile-time constant rather than resolved from rules_version
negative_cases.why: correct only by accident when the constant happens to match the domain; wrong the moment a domain settles elsewhere

negative_cases.name: leaf bound to a commitment_id
negative_cases.scenario: subtree_root replaced by a single accepted commitment_id
negative_cases.why: the leaf-bound field is the sub-tree root over the leaf's commitments (independence.proof/1 §10.4), not one member of it

must_hold: both preimages canonicalize in insertion order, never JCS
leaf_hash = SHA3-256(0x00 || bytes); the batch-binding digest has no domain prefix
the memo is the prefix "ccab1:" concatenated with the lowercase-hex digest
quantities keep their scale and stay strings
settlement_profile_id is resolved from rules_version, not from a constant
these values reproduce P001 exactly — a divergence here or there means one of the two is wrong
